description: Northstar support departments. Part 1 uses each route's `tier` to pick a MODEL for a question (deterministic vector routing). Part 3 uses the same routes to pick an AGENT: the tier plus a tool list and a slice of the knowledge base. Utterances are example requests; a new request is matched to the route whose closest utterance is nearest in embedding space.

routes.name: orders
routes.description: Physical orders: refunds, returns, restocking fees, shipping times, delivery problems, and replacements.
utterances: I want my money back for an order
How do I send an item back?
My package arrived broken
Is there a fee for returning something I already opened?
When will my delivery get here?
Can you ship a replacement for a defective product?
Do you deliver overnight or internationally?
Where is my refund? I returned the item last week
My tracking says delivered but I never got the box

routes.name: identity
routes.description: Account access: password resets, lockouts, two-factor authentication, and account recovery.
utterances: I can't sign in to my account
I forgot my password
The password reset email never arrived
My account is locked after too many login attempts
I lost my authenticator device for two-factor login
How do I recover my account without access to my old email?
I log in with Google, how do I change my credentials?
Someone may have my password, what should I do?

routes.name: billing
routes.description: Money owed to or by Northstar: invoices, failed charges, account pauses, taxes, invoice disputes, uptime commitments, and service credits.
utterances: My subscription payment was declined
Why is my account paused for non-payment?
I want to dispute the amount on my invoice
When is my invoice due?
What credit do we get for the outage last month?
What uptime do you guarantee?
How is sales tax calculated on my bill?
How fast do you tell us about a major incident?
Can I be billed in euros instead of dollars?

routes.name: platform
routes.description: The developer API: rate limits, 429 errors, API keys, idempotency, webhooks, and sandbox versus production.
utterances: Our integration keeps getting 429 Too Many Requests
How many API calls per minute are we allowed?
How do I create or revoke an API key?
Our webhook endpoint is not receiving events
What is an idempotency key and when do I need one?
We get a 403 when using our sandbox key in production
How do webhook retries work?
Can we raise our API request quota?

routes.name: privacy
routes.description: Data retention and deletion: how long records, logs, transcripts, and backups are kept, and what happens on a deletion request.
utterances: Please delete all the personal data you hold about me
How long do you keep my records after I close my account?
How long are chat transcripts stored?
Do you keep our logs, and for how long?
Is my card number stored on your servers?
How long do backups retain deleted data?
What is your data retention policy for EU customers?
When are sandbox test orders purged?
